result: All four mandatory source findings repaired; retained zero-byte final-guard regression now passes. New deterministic causal tests for R1/R2/R4 remain Test Writer work.
tree: feature/b.ftd; inherited HEAD 9ff393a5216fd6d6377d3b40a1adab491fa296c6 and existing uncommitted source/tests preserved; no commit

repairs.R1: Run captures mailbox epoch before admission.take (including slow eligibility reads), carries that bound epoch on an accepted terminalInput, and inputMailbox.put preserves it. A control between admission and insertion cannot reauthorize an affected submission using the new epoch; existing cancellation/drain/writer guards retire it.
repairs.R2: Every consumed interrupt/exit establishes the first cancellation deadline even while idle. Serial await no longer clears it after individual idle operations. The same deadline supervises control records, cancellation records, waiting reports and shutdown finalization; startup/completion/known-unwritten retirement no longer discard it. Recovery clears it only after the cancellation work and waiting report complete. Failure-cleanup transcript writes have a shared finite remaining budget, preventing a new unbounded defer. Existing owned-process termination remains authoritative; no ended report follows a failed protected record. Reset stale activeCancellation bookkeeping when its active submission finishes or retires.
repairs.R3: Final writer guard reports the errPromptRetired sentinel as known prewrite, sends the original disposition to prompt callback and continues the healthy transport without Write. Initial guard behavior remains. Actual partial/error/timeout paths still retire transport with uncertainty and no replay. Other final authority failures retain E2 fail-closed behavior, verified by retained allow/deny guard2 regression.
repairs.R4: Accepted initial submission is tracked in queue before submit performs runtime verification, user_input recording or UserPromptSubmit reporting. It remains tracked on pre-dispatch failure for healthy-transcript cancellation finalization; transfers to active ownership only after ACP request allocation, with queue removal on transfer or successful known-unstarted cancellation.

testability_seam.actual: Unexported runWithTranscript takes the transcript opener; public Run always passes existing protected openTranscript. transcript.file now uses the minimal Stat/Write/Sync/Close interface. Default remains the exact protected os.File, identity validation and synchronization unchanged; no environment, user option, public API or alternate production behavior.
testability_seam.why: Concrete *os.File previously prevented a deterministic blocked Sync/start-record test. An in-package test can open the real protected transcript, wrap its file, identify record kinds in Write and block/fail the following Sync. This observes actual control supervision and start-record-to-writer gate using the real Run implementation.
testability_seam.next_writer: Use runWithTranscript with real protected opener plus a blocking file wrapper. Exercise idle input_control Sync, busy/start-record Sync, repeated controls and original deadline; inspect raw peer bytes, owned-runtime termination and absence of false ended. Release every wrapper barrier in cleanup. Keep protected Stat and real Write/Sync delegation. The seam is in-process; it does not inject test behavior into an out-of-process CLI.
